name: Theater Camp in Lincoln Woods State Park
description_short: An outdoor theater day camp for ages 5-12 in Lincoln Woods State Park, running 8:30am to 3:30pm. Campers play theater games, do arts and crafts and make props and costumes, and each week ends with an outdoor performance.
activities: Theme days (water day, costume day, camp olympics)
swim_waterfront_notes: No swimming during camp. The park has a beach with lifeguards, and families can swim there after pickup (lifeguards are on duty until 6pm).
